breakdown.description: The torque-induced arc load is replaced by a fixed global-x traction instead of a tangential traction field
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly ignored the user's incorrect instruction to apply the traction as a fixed Cartesian vector `(M/(2*pi*r), 0)`. Instead, it correctly specified, in line with the ground truth, that 'The traction is applied in the local tangent direction of the indentation arc.'
